entries.reason: The headless test host guard checks the global Avalonia UI dispatcher slot between and after headless tests: leftover queued work, an unhandled exception, or a dispatcher that another thread created first. The slot is what it must observe, so the Core UiThread wrapper cannot replace it: the wrapper keeps its dispatcher outside the Avalonia slot, and TryGetRunningDispatcher returns false when Application.Current is null, which is the state between tests.
entries.review: Tier A: the owner approves the permanent seam in this pull request. Scope: this file only. No product code and no other test file uses the global slot.
